dedupe_keys.name: orszagos mentoszolgalat statistics hungary weekly ambulance and on call task counts by county and day and average arrival times for budapest and the country

description: The Hungarian National Ambulance Service publishes weekly statistics from its dispatch system on the workload of ambulances across the country. The statistics page shows the number of ambulance tasks for each county and Budapest on each day of the latest week, with the percentage change against the same day a year earlier, the equivalent counts for on-call medical tasks, and average arrival times for Budapest and for the whole country. When read, the page covered week 38 of 2026, with about 1,200 ambulance tasks a day in Budapest. The tables are free and available on the page as HTML; there is no file download, and no licence is stated. Caveats: only the current week is shown, so a time series has to be collected week by week, and the page does not define how arrival time is measured. Simulation uses: calibrating ambulance demand by county and weekday, checking modelled response times against published averages, and studying the effect of heatwaves or epidemics on emergency medical workload. Related records: Portugal's INEM prehospital activity (data-inem-portugal-prehospital-emergency-activity) and Ambulance Victoria incident statistics (data-ambulance-victoria-incident-statistics) are comparable national sources.
